g.text: C. Commit-to-start interval outside observed own GPU execution
Milliseconds per task; median and observed min/max
GPU spans include internal sync / memory stalls; uncovered submission time is not exclusive device-queue occupancy.
Return lag includes notification / handlers / CPU scheduling. Deferred decode may absorb waits; full CSV keeps both APIs.
Probe and bare controls, negative pairs and multi-second host/producer outliers are preserved in the report.
